title: Zesty Smoky Norwegian Cod Skillet
description: A quick and flavorful Norwegian dish featuring cod, desiccated coconut, and a smoky twist, all cooked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet. This high-protein friendly meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together the desiccated coconut, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the coconut oil to the preheated skillet and swirl it around to coat the bottom.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Norwegian cod fillets to the skillet, skin side up if they have skin.
Sprinkle the coconut mixture evenly over the cod fillets.
Cook the cod for 3-4 minutes, until the skin is crispy and golden brown.
Flip the cod over and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, until cooked through.
Remove the cod from the skillet and set it aside on a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the lemon juice to the skillet, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Simmer the lemon juice for 1-2 minutes, until slightly reduced and jammy.
Serve the cod fillets with the smoky coconut crust, topped with the jammy lemon sauce and chopped fresh parsley if desired.
